planning.description: Explore the codebase, clarify scope, and produce an implementation plan; do not edit.

quick.description: Small, well-bounded work where speed and cost matter most.

balanced.description: Default development work with a practical quality and cost tradeoff.

implementation.description: A multi-file feature or fix requiring careful reasoning and verification.

sustained.description: Well-specified work that may run for a while; favor low cost, good context, and low effort.

review.description: Independently verify correctness, regressions, tests, and evidence.

deep-review.description: Architecture, security, or high-risk work requiring maximum reasoning quality.
